what: A hash-shaped string in output was never flagged as possibly invented. A job's output contained a 40- or 64-character hexadecimal string that appeared nowhere verbatim in the job's own context files, suspiciously hash-shaped but never noticed to be unexplained.
rule: An unexplained 40/64-hex string in an output is flagged as possibly invented.
fix: Enforcement: `inspect`/`integrate` warn `invented-hash` when an output diff adds a 40-hex or 64-hex string not present verbatim in the job's own context files. Regression coverage is in `tests/lessons120-mutants.test.mjs`.
